description: Read a named agent run back by agent_session_id, name or subject. mode=history (default) returns the session's JSONL transcript; artifact returns the settle-time files — kind=report (the verbatim final report), kind=tool (step + tool_name, the archived output and its pre-truncation original when it existed) or kind=all (the file list); ast_summary returns the structural summary written at settle; inbox returns the messages queued for the session plus the most recent deliveries; context_files returns the files supplied at spawn (path, size, sha256), adding their content only with include_content=true. Use the identity the agent tool returned. artifact kind=tool also reads a main conversation's archived tool output with session_id plus tool_call_id (or step + tool_name); the archived path or the result's stdout_spill_path, never a guessed path. Other artifact kinds and all other modes serve named agent sessions only.
name: agent_out

agent_session_id.description: The agent session id the agent tool returned.

include_content.description: mode=context_files: read each recorded file's current content (default false returns path, size and sha256 only).

mode.description: What to read; defaults to history.

name.description: The session's profile-unique short name; alternative to the id and subject.

session_id.description: mode=artifact kind=tool: the main conversation's session id; omit to use the current conversation. Mutually exclusive with agent_session_id/subject.

step.description: mode=artifact kind=tool: the tool call's per-session step.

subject.description: The agent session's unique subject; alternative to the id.

tool_call_id.description: mode=artifact kind=tool: a conversation tool call's id. Mutually exclusive with agent identity.

tool_name.description: mode=artifact kind=tool: the tool whose output to read.
